reuse.why: Uses the shared assertNotLinkedElsewhere, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and the akahu balance branch, but builds the link and download functions by copying the Akahu ones rather than extracting a shared provider routine.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount (~75 lines) and downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions apart from the server key and log text.

placement.why: Each piece goes where the tree puts its provider counterparts: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, base path in server-config.ts, provider list and account type in types/models.

scope.why: Focused on the Fintegra server side; the two desktop-client edits are minimal ones forced by the exhaustive BankSyncProviders records.

maintainability.why: Follows the existing per-provider pattern, but adds a sixth copy of the link flow and a second identical token/post/error-mapping download, so fixes must be repeated per provider.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The shared link precondition, bank lookup, sync and response handling are all used; no existing abstraction is skipped.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of linkAkahuAccount and downloadAkahuTransactions are open, with only names and the provider key changed.
